text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card and the tool outputs (8 of 30 below billed, 5 of 9 99215s, 18.9% vs 1.9% expected, 71% low complexity, $1,955 estimate with CI, and the follow-up exchange). Headline is clear. Language is cautious (\"consistent with\", \"needs human review\"). Next steps are concrete. Weaknesses: one cited claim has a wrong age, the rationale repeats itself, and the cited claims lean on documented examples that include some thin evidence.","problems":["C0208975 is described as patient aged 58 with 0 chronic conditions, but the card lists 0 conditions age 58 with hyperlipidemia (1 condition, age 66 in the card row); the age/condition description does not match the card row for that claim.","Rationale repeats the 18.9% vs 1.9% expected figure twice, which adds length without information.","Cited claims C0208854, C0208861 and C0208865 have no documentation review, so they support only the low-complexity point and not the documented-below-billed point; the mix of example types is not explained.","The estimate of $1,955 is presented without a clear statement that it is an extrapolation from a 30-claim sample.","The next step about copied-forward notes is not tied to any evidence in the packet; it is generic.","Missing context is only lightly flagged, for example the one claim of moderate data reviewed without a lab line and the missing minutes on several examples."]}
